sourceObservations: Fractal bounding is the reciprocal of the absolute-gain amplitude sum.
The constructor defaults to three octaves, lacunarity two, gain one half and weighted strength zero.
fBm sums signed octave noise while ridged maps each octave through one minus twice its absolute value.
Weighted-strength documentation constrains the parameter to zero through one to retain the advertised output bound.
notEstablishedBySource: zero mean or a fixed output distribution
an exact spectral bandwidth for each octave
